title: Not letting go: tRNA sequestration as a unifying mechanism driving synthetase-linked neuropathies
title_zh: 不放手：tRNA沉积作为驱动合成酶相关神经病的统一机制
abstract: This scientific commentary refers to ‘Tyrosyl-tRNA sequestration triggers tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase-associated peripheral neuropathy’, by Mallik et al. (https://doi.org/10.1093/brain/awag204).
abstract_zh: 本科学性评论引用了Mallik等人（https://doi.org/10.1093/brain/awag204）的研究：‘Tyrosyl-tRNA沉积诱发丝氨酰-tRNA合成酶相关周围神经病’。
